_comment: Instructions per iteration for the declared hot paths, measured by scripts/bench.sh as the difference between 2N and N iterations under callgrind. Rewriting this is a deliberate act with a reason in the commit message. The ten non-cache figures are bit-identical on a developer machine and on a GitHub runner. The six pgprox-cache figures are not, and are the median of six CI runs: see run-2026-08-06-ci-baseline.md.
